item.title: Araghchi urges UN to react to unlawful US sanctions
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi published on Wednesday a letter to United Nations Secretary-General Antonio Guterres in which he urged the organization and the UN Security Council to respond to the United States' latest economic offensive against his country.
item.content:encoded:

Tehran, IRNA – Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi published on Wednesday a letter to United Nations Secretary-General Antonio Guterres in which he urged the organization and the UN Security Council to respond to the United States' latest economic offensive against his country.

item.title: Iran says US is angry because it failed to force Tehran to surrender
item.description: Rasht, IRNA – The United States is angry because it has failed to force Iran to surrender, Vice President for Executive Affairs Mohammad Jafar Ghaempanah said on Wednesday, noting that Tehran’s resistance had prompted Washington to shift from threats to calls for negotiations.
